Manhattan Active SCALE Documentation
        Shipping Web Services
    
    
         
                Collapse All
                Expand All
            
        View with Navigation Tools
    
    
    
    
    
        The following web services are all related to the Shipping functional area of the application:




    
        
            Web Service

            Description
        

        
            Address Validation

            Invokes Address Validation for a single address or a list of addresses.
        

        
            Close Container

            Invokes Close Container for a single shipping container.
        

        
            Force QC

            Allows a consumer to pass QC for a Shipping container without actually verifying the item contents.
        

        
            Immediate Dock Transfer

            Immediately transfers a shipping container between shipping dock locations without creating dock management work.
        

        
            Multi Order Pallet Immediate Dock Transfer

            Allows for the immediate transfer of a multi order pallet between shipping dock locations.
        

        
            Multi Order Pallet Nesting

            Provides the ability to nest a shipping container on a multi order pallet.
        

        
            Multi Order Pallet Unnesting

            Provides the ability to unnest a shipping container from a multi order pallet.
        

        
            Pallet Building

            Builds Pallets for a wave or a list of Shipping Containers.
        

        
            QC Assignment

            Invokes QC assignment on a list of Shipping Containers.
        

        
            QC Confirmation

            Invokes QC confirmation for contents of a Shipping Container.
        

        
            Rating

            Calculates freight rates for a shipment
        

        
            Rate Shopping

            Invokes Rate Shopping.
        

        
            Shipping

            Allows access to links (URL or URI template) to web services related to shipping.
        

        
            Shipping Container

            Allows access to a Shipping Container.
        

        
            VAS Confirmation

            Invokes VAS confirmation of a list of activities for a list of Shipping Containers.
